messages:
jin: FYI - kirin15b (int4) canary started OOMing on long-gen workloads after yesterday's attention patch. Repro steps below.

leo: ugh. short summary?

jin: Synth repro: prompt ~980 tokens, client requested max_new_tokens=1500, continuous batching, batch_size=4 local repro, prod default is 8. generation_window=2048. OOM during KV growth.

jin: ```
[2026-03-22T19:05:12Z] ERROR OOM: alloc failed size=268435456
[2026-03-22T19:05:12Z] model=kirin15b variant=int4 node=canary-7 peak=11.7GB pid=2345
[2026-03-22T19:05:12Z] kv_cache: before=1.6GB after=5.9GB delta=4.3GB
stack: allocator::new_chunk -> slab::split -> kv_cache::append -> attention::prefetch
```

tara: Important to know kernels and slot_reserve. Which prefetch/profile?

jin: Kernel=03-21-attn-opt, prefetch=enabled, prefix_cache=true, kv_gc=auto, slot_reserve=0.1, batcher=continuous.

leo: Two immediate causes in my head: (1) prefetch expands KV early and fragments heap with many small allocations; (2) concurrent batches (prod 8) cause KV bursts that exceed slot_reserve.

mike: For mitigation, propose quick canary changes: 
- set default_max_new_tokens=512 for kirin15b on hosted/dedicated (policy override)
- enforce batch_size cap=4 for requests where client_max_new > 1024 (soft microbatching)
- bump slot_reserve to 0.2 on canary nodes
- enable windowed-evict (soft evict at 75% kv usage)
- if needed, rollback 03-21-attn-opt kernel for this variant to last stable kernel

tara: Agree. Also add a probe to trace allocator fragmentation (malloc stats) during soak. Want p95 latency, p99 tail mem, and OOM count.

jin: I'll run A/B: baseline vs mitigations. Plan: 30m synthetic soak (mixed lengths incl 1k+ gens) + 1h live-sample at 10% traffic. Metrics: OOM, p95 latency, peak mem distribution.

leo: Add one more: try slot_reserve=0.15 first? 0.2 might waste capacity. But for soak ok to test 0.2.

mike: Note: microbatching will slightly increase client-observed latency, but should prevent simultaneous KV expansion. We measured ~8% p95 hit on similar model previously with cap=4.

deploy-bot: deploy request created id=deploy-1764444600. Config: default_max_new_tokens=512, batch_size_cap=4 for large-gen, slot_reserve=0.2, windowed_evict=on. Rolling to 3 canaries.

jin: starting soak now. Posting interim after 45m.

tara: Acceptance: 0 OOMs during soak AND p95 delta < 10%. If pass, roll to 25% for 24h and run full quantized-eval to check quality drift.

mike: Also schedule a follow-up to test reverting the 03-21 kernel vs enabling alternate kernel variant that has windowed-alloc optimizations.

jin: noted. will include malloc-frag traces and flame graphs in follow-up.
